about: The studio page's modules and editions (the owner, 17 November 2026: "Factor the studio and live-dial-studio pages for easy maintenance, so that modules can easily be included or excluded"). The studio's own (public/studio/studio.js) is the band and the piece chosen, the progress, the notes on the render and everything in one ZIP; what it makes of a piece is its modules', each a file public/studio/modules/<name>.js with its box and what it does with a piece. `modules` are in the page's order; `place` is where a module's box goes (results: what the piece gives; tools: what works on it), `heading` its word in the results' heading. An edition is the page with the modules it lists: to include a module, add its name to the edition's `modules`; to leave one out, take it off and say why in its `without`. One grammar with the live-dial studio page's (native/live/page.json): public/shared/page-editions.js; docs/PAGE_MODULES.md; test/studio-modules.test.mjs.

modules.name: score
modules.about: The piece as it is written: its score and parts engraved by LilyPond in WebAssembly, their MusicXML, and its MIDI 2.0 (each part's clip, and every part in one clip on the score's bars).
modules.heading: score

modules.name: sound
modules.about: The piece as it sounds: each part played on its physical model, the band's desk mixing them, the mix mastered with its stems (WAV, and MP3 where the build has its encoder).
modules.heading: sound

modules.name: editor
modules.about: The piece's parts in the MIDI 2.0 editor, framed in the page, and the parts as edited there played on their models again.
modules.heading: parts

page.about: The studio's own page (public/studio.html; its static site, scripts/build-studio-site.mjs): every module.

band.about: The studio as the live-dial studio page's Band (native/live/modules/band/band.js): every module, with the players dialled on that page.

written.about: The piece written and not played: its score, parts, MusicXML and MIDI 2.0 alone, on a machine too slow to play the models or where only the writing is wanted. Used by no page until one names it (studio.html?edition=written; scripts/build-studio-site.mjs --edition written); a page that takes it up says so in its own words: studio.html's opening lines, and the band's rows, speak of the models' playing.

without.sound: this edition is the piece as written: nothing is played, so no engine is fetched and no audio made
without.editor: the editor's use is to play its edited parts on the models, which this edition does not play; the piece's MIDI 2.0 is among the score's files
